arxiv-1710-06715.title: Higgs compositeness in Sp ⁡ ( 2 ​ N ) \mathrm{Sp}(2N) gauge theories — Resymplecticisation, scale setting and topology
arxiv-1710-06715.creator: \firstname Ed \lastname Bennett \fnsep \fnsep, \firstname Deog Ki \lastname Hong \fnsep, \firstname Jong-Wan \lastname Lee \fnsep \fnsep, \firstname C.-J. David \lastname Lin \fnsep, \firstname Biagio \lastname Lucini \fnsep \fnsep, \firstname Maurizio \lastname Piai \fnsep, \firstname Davide \lastn
arxiv-1710-06715.description: Abstract As part of an ongoing programme to study Sp ⁡ ( 2 ​ N ) \mathrm{Sp}(2N) gauge theories as potential realisations of composite Higgs models, we consider the case of Sp ⁡ ( 4 ) \mathrm{Sp}(4) on the lattice, both as a pure gauge theory, and with two Dirac fermion flavors in the fundamental representation.

arxiv-2103-09425.title: Bolt-Dumbo Transformer: Asynchronous Consensus As Fast As the Pipelined BFT CCS: Security and privacy Systems security; Distributed systems security CCS: Computer systems organization Reliability
arxiv-2103-09425.creator: Yuan Lu, Zhenliang Lu, Qiang Tang
arxiv-2103-09425.description: Abstract . An urgent demand of deploying BFT consensus (e.g., atomic broadcast) over the Internet is raised for implementing (permissioned) blockchain services. The deterministic (partial) synchronous protocols can be simple and fast in good network conditions, but are subject to denial-of-service (or even safety vulnerability) when synchrony assumption fails.

arxiv-2106-03440.title: The cohomology of the free loop spaces of S ​ U ​ ( n + 1 ) / T n SU(n+1)/T^{n} Thanks: Research supported in part by The Leverhulme Trust Research Project Grant RPG-2012-560.
arxiv-2106-03440.creator: Matthew I. Burfitt, Jelena Grbić
arxiv-2106-03440.description: Abstract . We study the cohomology of the free loop space of S ​ U ​ ( n + 1 ) / T n SU(n+1)/T^{n} , the simplest example of a complete flag manifolds and an important homogeneous space. Through this enhanced analysis we reveal rich new combinatorial structures arising in the cohomology algebra of the free loop spaces.

arxiv-2204-05173.title: Machine Learning State-of-the-Art with Uncertainties
arxiv-2204-05173.creator: Peter Steinbach, Felicita Gernhardt, Mahnoor Tanveer, Steve Schmerler, Sebastian Starke
arxiv-2204-05173.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Peter Steinbach, Felicita Gernhardt, Mahnoor Tanveer, Steve Schmerler, Sebastian Starke. With the availability of data, hardware, software ecosystem and relevant skill sets, the machine learning community is undergoing a rapid development with new architectures and approaches appearing at high frequency every year. In this article, we conduct an exemplary image classification study in order to demonstrate how confidence intervals around accuracy measurements can greatly enhance the communication of research results as well as impact the reviewing process.

arxiv-2211-10649.title: LibSignal: An Open Library for Traffic Signal Control
arxiv-2211-10649.creator: Hao Mei, Xiaoliang Lei, Longchao Da, Bin Shi, Hua Wei
arxiv-2211-10649.description: Abstract This paper introduces a library for cross-simulator comparison of reinforcement learning models in traffic signal control tasks. This library is developed to implement recent state-of-the-art reinforcement learning models with extensible interfaces and unified cross-simulator evaluation metrics. It supports commonly-used simulators in traffic signal control tasks, including Simulation of Urban MObility(SUMO) and CityFlow, and multiple benchmark datasets for fair comparisons.

arxiv-2301-03346.title: Physical and dynamical properties of selected Earth co-orbital asteroids
arxiv-2301-03346.creator: Galin B. Borisov, Apostolos A. Christou, Gordana Apostolovska
arxiv-2301-03346.description: Abstract We present our investigations of the physical and dynamical properties of selected Earth co-orbital asteroids. The photometric optical light curves as well as rotation periods and pole solutions for a sample of four Earth co-orbital asteroids, namely (138175) 2000 EE104 (P=13.9476 ± \pm 0.0051 hrs), (418849) 2008 WM64 (P=2.4077 ± \pm 0.0001 hrs), 2016 CA138 (P=5.3137 ± \pm 0.

arxiv-2308-11195.title: Superconductivity from Doping Symmetric Mass Generation Insulators: Application to La 3 Ni 2 O 7 under Pressure
arxiv-2308-11195.creator: Da-Chuan Lu, Miao Li, Zhao-Yi Zeng, Wanda Hou, Juven Wang, Fan Yang, Yi-Zhuang You
arxiv-2308-11195.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Da-Chuan Lu, Miao Li, Zhao-Yi Zeng, Wanda Hou, Juven Wang, Fan Yang, Yi-Zhuang You. We investigate the bilayer nickelates as a platform to realize the symmetric mass generation (SMG) insulator, a featureless Mott insulator that arises due to the Lieb-Schultz-Mattis (LSM) anomaly cancellation in bilayer spin-1/2 lattice systems. Through a single-orbital bilayer square lattice model involving intralayer hopping t t and interlayer superexchange interaction J J , we demonstrate the emergence of high-temperature superconductivity (SC) upon doping the SMG insulator.

arxiv-2309-12090.title: Multi-Task Cooperative Learning via Searching for Flat Minima
arxiv-2309-12090.creator: Fuping Wu, Le Zhang, Yang Sun, Yuanhan Mo, Thomas Nichols, Bartłomiej W. Papież
arxiv-2309-12090.description: Abstract Multi-task learning (MTL) has shown great potential in medical image analysis, improving the generalizability of the learned features and the performance in individual tasks. However, most of the work on MTL focuses on either architecture design or gradient manipulation, while in both scenarios, features are learned in a competitive manner.

arxiv-2310-06743.title: Geographic Location Encoding with Spherical Harmonics and Sinusoidal Representation Networks
arxiv-2310-06743.creator: Marc Rußwurm, Konstantin Klemmer, Esther Rolf, Robin Zbinden & Devis Tuia
arxiv-2310-06743.description: Abstract Learning representations of geographical space is vital for any machine learning model that integrates geolocated data, spanning application domains such as remote sensing, ecology, or epidemiology. Recent work embeds coordinates using sine and cosine projections based on Double Fourier Sphere (DFS) features.

arxiv-2406-05612.title: Which Backbone to Use: A Resource-efficient Domain Specific Comparison for Computer Vision
arxiv-2406-05612.creator: Pranav Jeevan P Amit Sethi
arxiv-2406-05612.description: Abstract In contemporary computer vision applications, particularly image classification, architectural backbones pre-trained on large datasets like ImageNet are commonly employed as feature extractors. Despite the widespread use of these pre-trained convolutional neural networks (CNNs), there remains a gap in understanding the performance of various resource-efficient backbones across diverse domains and dataset sizes.

arxiv-2410-20861.title: Beyond Baby Blues: The Child Penalty in Mental Health in Switzerland
arxiv-2410-20861.creator: Nora Bearth
arxiv-2410-20861.description: Abstract Abstract This paper investigates the mental health penalty for women after childbirth in Switzerland. Leveraging insurance data, we employ a staggered difference-in-difference research design. The findings reveal a substantial mental health penalty for women following the birth of their first child. Approximately four years after childbirth, there is a one percentage point (p.p.

arxiv-2506-02793.title: Doubly-Robust Estimation of Counterfactual Policy Mean Embeddings
arxiv-2506-02793.creator: Houssam Zenati, Bariscan Bozkurt, Arthur Gretton
arxiv-2506-02793.description: Abstract Estimating the distribution of outcomes under counterfactual policies is critical for decision-making in domains such as recommendation, advertising, and healthcare. We analyze a novel framework—Counterfactual Policy Mean Embedding (CPME)—that represents the entire counterfactual outcome distribution in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS), enabling flexible and nonparametric distributional off-policy evaluation.

arxiv-2602-22873.title: Learning Tangent Bundles and Characteristic Classes with Autoencoder Atlases
arxiv-2602-22873.creator: Eduardo Paluzo-Hidalgo, Yuichi Ike
arxiv-2602-22873.description: Abstract We introduce a theoretical framework that connects multi-chart autoencoders in manifold learning with the classical theory of vector bundles and characteristic classes. Rather than viewing autoencoders as producing a single global Euclidean embedding, we treat a collection of locally trained encoder–decoder pairs as a learned atlas on a manifold.

catholic-encyclopedia-1913-ansegisus-arc.creator: Michael Ott
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-ansegisus-arc.description: Article 'Ansegisus (Archbishop of Sens)' from the Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), the 15-volume English-language reference work published 1907-1914 by Robert Appleton Company.

pmc-10542678.title: Effects of allyl isothiocyanate fumigation on medicinal plant root knot disease control, plant survival, and the soil bacterial community
pmc-10542678.creator: Yingbin Li, Daqing Lu, Yan Xia, Xinjing Xu, Huichuan Huang, Xinyue Mei, Min Yang, Jianqiang Li, Shusheng Zhu, Yixiang Liu, Zhiping Zhang
pmc-10542678.description: BackgroundAllyl isothiocyanate (AITC) is a natural product with high volatility that is used as a biofumigant to alleviate soil-borne plant diseases, and problems such as root knot nematodes (RKNs) that necessitate continuous cropping. However, little research has assessed the effects of AITC fumigation on medicinal plants.ResultsAITC significantly reduced the population of RKNs in soil (p < 0.

pmc-10738440.title: NEED-BASED INTERVENTION DELIVERY FOR FAMILY CAREGIVERS OF OLDER ADULTS WITH DEMENTIA
pmc-10738440.creator: Jaclene Zauszniewski, Christopher Burant, Alexandra Jeanblanc, Evanne Juratovac
pmc-10738440.description: The literature on family caregivers of persons with Alzheimer’s or other dementias abounds with studies of psychoeducational or cognitive-behavioral interventions to reduce stress and promote mental health. However, the determination of the caregiver’s need for specific interventions is rarely documented or based on clinical judgment. Researchers typically assume an intervention was needed when positive outcomes emerge.

pmc-11343902.title: Immune Cell Contribution to Mammary Gland Development
pmc-11343902.creator: Ramiah Vickers, Weston Porter
pmc-11343902.description: Postpartum breast cancer (PPBC) is a unique subset of breast cancer, accounting for nearly half of the women diagnosed during their postpartum years. Mammary gland involution is widely regarded as being a key orchestrator in the initiation and progression of PPBC due to its unique wound-healing inflammatory signature.

pmc-11661398.title: Microbiological indoor air quality and associated factors in private clinics of Harar Town, Eastern Ethiopia
pmc-11661398.creator: Liku Muche Temesgen, Tamagnu Sintie Alamirew, Salie Mulat Endalew, Bealemlay Abebe Melake, Wegene Deriba Regassa, Sina Temesgen Tolera, Molla Getie Mehari
pmc-11661398.description: BackgroundIndoor air pollution, including airborne microorganisms, can cause allergies, respiratory diseases, and immune-toxic diseases. Sneezing generates millions of airborne microbial infections, and ventilation sources alter microbial communities. Few studies exist in developing countries, including Ethiopia, and Harar Town. The aim is to assess microbial indoor air quality and associated factors among private clinics, Harar town, Eastern Ethiopia.

pmc-12431549.title: Efficient Deep Learning-Based Arrhythmia Detection Using Smartwatch ECG Electrocardiograms
pmc-12431549.creator: Herwin Alayn Huillcen Baca, Flor de Luz Palomino Valdivia
pmc-12431549.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). According to the World Health Organization, cardiovascular diseases, including cardiac arrhythmias, are the leading cause of death worldwide due to their silent, asymptomatic nature. To address this problem, early and accurate diagnosis is crucial. Although this task is typically performed by a cardiologist, diagnosing arrhythmias can be imprecise due to the subjectivity of reading and interpreting electrocardiograms (ECGs), and electrocardiograms are often subject to noise and interference.

pmc-12498052.title: Synthesis, crystal structure and Hirshfeld surface analysis of (2-amino­benzo­thia­zole-κN3)aqua­bis­(4-oxopent-2-en-2-olato-κ2O,O′)cobalt(II)
pmc-12498052.creator: Iroda Tojiboyeva, Sardor Murodov, Lola Makhmudova, Daminbek Ziyatov, Jamshid Ashurov, Shakhlo Daminova
pmc-12498052.description: The crystal structure of the cobalt complex [Co(C5H7O2)2(C7H6N2S)(H2O)] was determined in the triclinic space group Pī. The unit cell consists of two independent complex mol­ecules linked by N—H⋯O and O—H⋯O hydrogen bonds along the [011] direction. Hirshfeld surface analysis revealed that the largest contributions to the crystal packing originate from H⋯H, H⋯C/C⋯H, O⋯H/H⋯O, and H⋯S/S⋯H contacts.

pmc-12706014.title: Automated skin cancer detection using MedFusionNet with attention-based fusion of ConvNeXt and vision transformer
pmc-12706014.creator: Muhammad Ahtsam Naeem, Shangming Yang, Muhammad Asim Saleem, Iram Javed, Ashir Javeed
pmc-12706014.description: Skin cancer, especially melanoma, the most severe type, has increased in recent decades. It develops from cells that grow abnormally and can invade the surrounding tissue and spread throughout the body. Early and accurate diagnosis is essential to prevent disease progression and allow for less invasive clinical treatment.

pmc-12786968.title: Multifunctional NADES-Based Extracts from Paeonia lactiflora Pall. Flowers for Potential Cosmetic and Pharmaceutical Applications
pmc-12786968.creator: Carla Villa, Eleonora Russo, Anna Maria Schito, Francesco Saverio Robustelli della Cuna, Cristina Sottani, Marta Barabino, Debora Caviglia
pmc-12786968.description: Paeonia lactiflora Pall. is a perennial herbaceous plant widely renowned for its floral ornamental appeal, distinctive pleasant scent, and utilization in folk remedies. Roots and barks are traditionally used in Chinese medicine for various properties, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, antibacterial, anticancer, cardiovascular, and neuroprotective effects.

pmc-12985901.title: The Effect of Duloxetine on Fusion in Rats Undergoing Posterolateral Spinal Fusion
pmc-12985901.creator: Ozan Güner, Murat Erem, Mert Çiftdemir, Ufuk Usta, Nermin Tunçbilek
pmc-12985901.description: Background: Duloxetine, a serotonin–norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor, is widely used both preoperatively and postoperatively in patients with neuropathic low back pain. This study aimed to determine the impact of duloxetine administration on posterolateral spinal fusion in rats and to evaluate the dose-dependent relationship of this effect.

pmc-13272554.title: Inclusive education for people with intellectual disabilities: Insights from a COST action training school
pmc-13272554.creator: Margaret Denny, Laura Widger, Oliwia Kowalczyk, Spela Golubovic, Dragana Milutinović, Suzanne Denieffe
pmc-13272554.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectivesPeople with intellectual and developmental disabilities (PWIDD) face persistent inequalities in accessing inclusive and health education. This contributes to lower participation in cancer screening, limited access to tailored health information, and poorer health outcomes. This study aimed to develop and evaluate a co-produced, pan-European COST Action CUPID Training School applying Universal Design for Learning (UDL) to improve cancer prevention education and health literacy for PWIDD.Study designCo-produced, pan-European training intervention.MethodsA cross-European Training School was collaboratively developed by researchers, health professionals, educators, and PWIDD.

pmc-13411393.title: A Chiral Saddle‐Shaped Nanographene With Two Heptagon‐Embedded [4]Helicenes
pmc-13411393.creator: Felix Trautner, Boris Borrisov, Philipp Royla, Hongqing Zhao, Hartmut Komber, Li Wan, Evgenia Dmitrieva, Ji Ma, Jan J. Weigand, Qun Yang, Xinliang Feng, Wenhui Niu
pmc-13411393.description: Chiral non‐benzenoid nanographenes (NGs) remain highly appealing, yet underexplored synthetic targets due to the lack of feasible synthetic strategies to simultaneously construct non‐hexagonal rings and stable chirality. Herein, we demonstrate a novel synthetic strategy to construct a chiral saddle‐shaped nanographene (cSNG) via stepwise oxidation of an anthracene‐containing oligophenylene precursor.

pmc-13414138.title: Anaplasma spp. in domestic ruminants: evidence of circulation and molecular analysis of Anaplasma phagocytophilum and Anaplasma capra in Slovakia
pmc-13414138.creator: Maroš Kostičák, Monika Drážovská, Božena Kočíková, Jakub Lipinský, Andrea Pelegrinová, Patrícia Petroušková, Anna Ondrejková, Ľuboš Korytár, Boris Vojtek, Katarína Franková, Jana Mojžišová Vaščinec, Kristína Hudáková, Marián Prokeš
pmc-13414138.description: The geographic expansion of ticks in Europe has increased exposure to tick-borne pathogens, particularly Anaplasma phagocytophilum, the causative agent of anaplasmosis in humans and animals. The recently described A. capra has raised interest as an emerging tick-borne agent with potential veterinary and public health relevance. This study aimed primarily to assess the molecular occurrence of A.

pmc-13529814.title: Safety reporting in chronic kidney disease clinical trials: a comparison of ClinicalTrials.gov registries and published reports
pmc-13529814.creator: Nevada Denton, Lydia Hashemi, Daniel Archer, Rachel Hazlitt, Logan Corwin, Ryan Sherry, Kellen Keefer, Alicia Ito Ford, Matt Vassar
pmc-13529814.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). because of polypharmacy, reduced renal clearance, and high comorbidity burden. Since 2007, the FDA Amendments Act (FDAAA 801) and its 2017 Final Rule have required applicable clinical trials to submit structured harms data to ClinicalTrials.gov [1]. Although discrepancies between registry and published harms data have been documented in other clinical domains, whether this registry information is faithfully reflected in the peer-reviewed literature for CKD trials specifically had not been examined [2].

pmc-13649332.title: “My Tears Have Been My Food, Both Day and Night”: Integrating Theology and Psychology on the Nature of Grief
pmc-13649332.creator: Daniel Lee Hill, Sierra Wickline, Angie S LeRoy
pmc-13649332.description: Recent work on theological reflection on the phenomenon of human grief has called for an apophatic posture, one that resists speaking positively about what grief is, what grief does, or where it is situated with respect to the economy of God’s works. Grief, on this account, is viewed as inaccessible to theological inquiry and illogical in nature.

pmc-13662595.title: Host phylogeny and diet shape gut microbiome and virome in wild small mammals of Gongga Mountain, China
pmc-13662595.creator: Le-Wei He, Rui-Xiang Tang, Shao-Ying Liu, Zhen-Jie Zhang, Yi Li, Xu-Ming Wang, Bi-Song Yue, Zhen-Xin Fan
pmc-13662595.description: Gut microbiotas play pivotal roles in host adaptation, yet their composition and function in high-altitude small mammals remain poorly characterized. This study investigated how host phylogeny (order-level) and dietary habits shape the gut microbiome and virome of three mammalian orders (Eulipotyphla, Rodentia, Lagomorpha) in Gongga Mountain, a biodiversity hotspot on the Qinghai-Xizang Plateau.

uslaw-usc-t22-s2701a.title: 22 U.S.C. § 2701a — Education allowance for dependents of Department of State employees located in United States territories
uslaw-usc-t22-s2701a.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t22-s2701a.description: United States Code, Title 22 (Foreign Relations And Intercourse); Chapter 38 (Department Of State). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) In general An individual employed by the Department at a location described in subsection (b) shall be eligible for a cost-of-living allowance for the education of the dependents of such employee in an amount that does not exceed the educational allowance authorized.
